menus:
  - id: menu.admin
    key: menu.admin

    name: Admin Tools
    title: Admin Tools
    label: Admin Tools
    position: Sub
    parent: menu.main
    order: 3
    type: admin
    icon: "🧰"

    visibilityMode: Conditional

      - admin_tools

      text: Admin Tools
      style: header
      colourScheme: header
      borderScheme: default
      visibilityMode: Conditional
      visibilityCondition: user_is_admin == true
      visibilityDependencies:
        - user_is_admin

      text: Admin access required
      style: footer
      colourScheme: footer
      borderScheme: default
      visibilityMode: Conditional
      visibilityCondition: user_is_admin == true
      visibilityDependencies:
        - user_is_admin
    items:
      - udi: prismata.menu.admin.logs
        key: admin.logs
        name: View Logs
        label: View Logs
        type: action
        order: 1
        selectionMethod: number
        action: execute
        ui_framework: menu
        capability: prismata.admin.view_logs
        executeTarget: view_logs

        visibilityCondition: user_is_admin == true
